# KBD Constraints — Charcoal Agent

Generated by `/kbd-init` on 2026-09-23. The project has no `AGENTS.md` "Never Do"
section, so the blocking rules below are the generic KBD defaults adapted to this
stack (Vite/React/TypeScript + Tauri shell) plus rules derived from `CLAUDE.md`.

Commands use `npm` (Dockerfile builds with `npm ci`; `package-lock.json` is the
authoritative lockfile). No mandatory command wrapper or `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` policy
is defined for this project.

Path ownership: `.claude/`, `.agents/`, `.opencode/`, `.kimi-code/` and `openspec/`
are repository-owned tool configuration (OpenSpec skills/commands), not disposable
state — do not delete or regenerate them as part of a change. Reference workspace
folders (see `project.json` → `workspace.folders`) are read-only.

---

## Blocking Constraints (prevent archiving until resolved)

```yaml
constraints:
  - id: build-passes
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Vite production build must pass'
    command: 'npm run build'

  - id: tests-pass
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Vitest suite must pass (skills-sync integration test self-skips without a UAR)'
    command: 'npm test'

  - id: no-console-log-in-commits
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No console.log in committed TypeScript (console.error/warn for real error paths is allowed)'
    check: "grep -rn 'console\\.log' src/ --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx'"

  - id: no-any-type
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No new `: any` in TypeScript source (1 pre-existing occurrence at init; do not add more)'
    check: "grep -rn ': any' src/ --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx'"

  - id: no-hardcoded-secrets
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No hardcoded API keys/tokens; UAR auth comes only from VITE_UAR_API_KEY'
    check: "grep -rn 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]\\{8,\\}\\|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9]\\{16,\\}' src/"

  - id: no-env-files-committed
    severity: blocking
    description: '.env and .env.*.local must never be committed (only .env.example)'
    check: "git ls-files | grep -E '^\\.env($|\\.)' | grep -v '^\\.env\\.example$'"

  - id: reference-folders-read-only
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No writes to reference workspace folders (UAR, artifact-refiner, openfang)'
    note: 'Changes to the UAR contract are made in that repo separately; this project only consumes it'

  - id: pglite-migrations-append-only
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Existing entries in MIGRATIONS (src/lib/db/pglite.ts) must not be edited; add a new version instead'
    note: 'Review git diff of src/lib/db/pglite.ts'

  - id: pglite-not-prebundled
    severity: blocking
    description: '@electric-sql/pglite must remain in vite.config.ts optimizeDeps.exclude'
    check: "grep -q 'exclude: \\[\"@electric-sql/pglite\"\\]' vite.config.ts || echo MISSING"
```

---

## Warning Constraints (acknowledge before archiving)

```yaml
constraints:
  - id: no-lint-warnings
    severity: warning
    description: 'ESLint clean'
    command: 'npm run lint'

  - id: agui-contract-parity
    severity: warning
    description: 'New/changed AG-UI event handling in use-message-stream.ts matches UAR src/uar/api/sse.rs'
    note: 'Cross-check against the reference folder; flows are type → store action → stream case → render component'

  - id: assistant-ui-metadata
    severity: warning
    description: 'Every ThreadMessageLike produced in use-chat-runtime.ts carries metadata (and user messages attachments: [])'
    note: 'Manual review — missing fields crash @assistant-ui/react internals'

  - id: shadcn-components
    severity: warning
    description: 'UI uses shadcn/ui components from src/components/ui rather than raw HTML controls'

  - id: tests-for-new-features
    severity: warning
    description: 'Tests exist for new hooks, stores and utilities added in this change'

  - id: no-stub-comments
    severity: warning
    description: 'No TODO/FIXME/STUB/HACK comments in committed code'
    check: "grep -rn 'TODO\\|FIXME\\|STUB\\|HACK' src/"

  - id: accessibility-basics
    severity: warning
    description: 'New UI components have aria-label or semantic HTML'
    note: 'Manual review required'
```

---

## Workflow Triggers

```yaml
workflow_triggers:
  - event: on_iteration_complete
    action:
      type: command
      target: 'npm run build'

  - event: on_change_complete
    action:
      type: command
      target: 'npm test && npm run lint'

  - event: on_refinement_complete
    action:
      type: command
      target: "git add -A && git commit -m 'kbd: refine <change-id>'"
```

# Assessment — uar-integration › uar-capability-assessment

Date: 2026-10-02. Stage: assess. The deliverable of this child is an adjusted plan, not code; the one permitted code change is the UAR build fix (goal 1).

## Evidence base

| Source | What it is | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| Code inventory of UAR `origin/main` @ `6e0479eb` | Read-only audit, every present/partial claim cited file:line. Three load-bearing claims re-verified by hand (below). | Primary |
| `research/landscape.md` | 74 cited sources [L1]–[L74], ~55 primary, accessed 2026-10-02, from Firecrawl search + extraction. | Primary for the external norm |
| Deep-research package `runtime-capabilities-a-production-public-20261002-0325` | **Unusable.** Stalled at stage 01 with 0 sources after ~22 min; the daemon hard-caps `max_sources: 10`. Nothing below rests on it. | None |
| `docs/agent-led-site/agent-led-site.md` (§4–§8) and §10 (U1–U19) | The strategy and requirements being assessed. Its UAR audit is anchored at `e6a2caae`/`fefbf35e`, 16+ commits behind. | Requirements |
| Parent `plan.md` (12 changes) and canonical `progress.json` | Current phase plan and state. | Position |

Hand verification on `origin/main`:
- Guardrail blocking is opt-in: `block_on_injection: false` default (`src/config.rs:2736,2754`).
- Per-run budgets come from the agent artifact: `ThreadBudgets::from_artifact(&artifact)` → `ModelCallBudget::for_run(..., session.id(), artifact.id, ...)` (`src/uar/runtime/manager.rs:4550-4567`); fields at `src/uar/runtime/thread/policy_intersection.rs` (`max_tokens_per_turn`, `max_tokens_per_session`, `max_tool_calls_per_turn`, `max_cost_per_session_usd`, `rate_limit`).
- Site corpus size: 8 files, 2,627 words, ≈3.5k tokens (`content/knowledge/*.md`).

## Goal 1 — UAR image build: fixed, pending merge

- **Symptom:** `Build and Publish Images` on `main` failed since 2026-10-01 15:05 (run 36881586257): `failed to select a version for rmcp`. Not a compile error — resolution failed before compilation.
- **Root cause:** three Dependabot merges left `main` unresolvable.
  - `5b41a7f5` pinned `rmcp =3.4.1` in `tools/mcp-server-fetch` while the root crate pinned `=3.1.2`; exact pins in one workspace cannot unify.
  - #282 moved `wasmtime-wasi` to 48.0.1 in `Cargo.lock` only, outside the manifest's `"47"` (the manifest says wasmtime and wasmtime-wasi move together).
  - #281 moved `fastembed` to 6.0.1 in `Cargo.lock` only, outside the pinned 5.x line.
- **Fix:** root `rmcp` → `=3.4.1`; lock re-resolved inside manifest ranges (wasmtime-wasi/wiggle 47.0.3, fastembed 5.17.4, cap-std 4.0.2). **PR Prometheus-AGS/universal-agent-runtime#324.**
- **Verified:** `cargo check --features server-full,postgres-backend --bin universal-agent-runtime -p universal-agent-runtime -p mcp-server-fetch` on `nightly-2026-07-18` exits 0 (warnings only). The CI image build after merge is the integration check; not yet observed.
- **Recurrence risk:** Dependabot will repeat this for deliberately pinned crates. A `dependabot.yml` ignore/group rule is a follow-up, recorded in the PR.

## Capability matrix

Status is UAR `origin/main`. Owner is where the gap should close. "General" means closing it benefits UAR's other uses (BossFang sidecar, desktop/mobile, A2A orchestration, MCP hosting, multi-tenant SaaS, Postgres and headless profiles — all read from UAR's README, `docs/product-support-matrix.md` and `openspec/specs/`).

| # | Capability | UAR today | Site need | External norm | Owner | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Session delete / TTL / erasure across sessions, checkpoints, cost ledger, admission evidence | **Absent.** `/api/sessions*` routed to `legacy_sessions_route_disabled` (`src/server.rs:1631-1632`); persistence trait has no delete; retention sweeper in-memory only, disabled by default. | FR-20/FR-33 erasure; Phase 0 uses an operator purge. | Universal: ADK requires expiry on every session [L14]; LangGraph TTL [L11]; AgentCore lifetimes [L2][L8]; Agents SDK `clear_session` [L18]. | UAR | General |

Tracker is in-process, so not aggregated across replicas. | FR-36, U6, U18. | Budgets enforced across replicas (LiteLLM+Redis); Envoy Agent Router debits token buckets from response usage with ext_authz-supplied limits [L65][L66]. | **Site config now** (`knowme-site.json`); UAR for cross-replica | General |

| 10 | Per-identity rate limiting | Absent inside UAR (one unkeyed governor, `src/uar/security/rate_limit.rs`). | Abuse control. | Edge/gateway concern; per-IP fails against inference theft, bot verification needed [L30]. | Site server + gate; bot verification at edge | Site |
| 11 | Durable API keys | **Absent.** `InMemoryApiKeyStorage` only; no open change. | Moot for the site once gate JWTs land. | — | UAR | General (BossFang and other key users) |
| 12 | JWKS / ES256 | **Present** (#321, `src/uar/security/middleware.rs:266`). | FR-46. | — | Done | General |
| 13 | AG-UI / A2UI | Present (dual dialects, A2UI v0.9.1, three renderers). | Client-side fixes only; missing link/citation catalog component. | AG-UI 1.0 (2026-09-30) adds metadata + usage [L40]. | UAR (catalog component, AG-UI 1.0) | General |

| 16 | Conversation memory | Present, opt-in; per-request flag defaults on. | Must be off for a shared principal (FR-41). | Memory off or TTL'd for anonymous users [L14]. | Site server | Site |
| 17 | KB ingestion provenance | Operator-only write path today. | Poisoning resistance. | PoisonedRAG 90–97% with 5 texts [C16]. | Ops | General |
| 18 | AI disclosure | n/a | EU AI Act Art. 50(1) applies since 2026-08-02 [L48]. | Static label. | Site | Site |

## Findings that change the plan

- **F1. Two parent changes are canonically PENDING but their work has merged.**
  - `uar-kb-retrieval-embedding`: UAR #316.
  - `memory-server-ghcr-publish`: SMS #29.

  The plan must reconcile them: run each change's "done when" check and complete them through KBD. Until then the parent counters are wrong.
- **F2. The spend-ceiling question (U6/U18) is half answered inside UAR.** Per-agent and per-session ceilings can be set today in `knowme-site.json` `extensions.budgets`, enforced before each model call. What remains open:
  - aggregation across replicas;
  - whether gate needs to see usage at all if UAR enforces. If it does, the Agent Router / ext_authz pattern [L65][L66] is the known design.
- **F3. Injection blocking is a config flag, not a project.** Add `block_on_injection: true` for the site deployment to the Phase 0 checklist. It is probabilistic, so it does not replace tool-less design [C15].
- **F4. The site may not need retrieval at all.** The corpus is ≈3.5k tokens, under 2% of the ≈200k threshold below which putting the whole corpus in context beats RAG [L56]. That would remove U3 from the site's critical path.

  It conflicts with the strategy that visitors use the technology KnowMe sells, which includes KB retrieval. **Operator decision.** The chunking fix stays a general UAR change either way.
- **F5. Session delete/TTL (U2) is the clearest general UAR gap.** Every surveyed platform has it. It is a GDPR blocker for every UAR deployment with real users, not a site quirk, so it belongs on the UAR roadmap regardless of the site.
- **F6. Per-IP rate limits are insufficient for a public LLM endpoint** [L30]. Bot verification on the chat route (Turnstile or equivalent) is missing from the site plan. It is a site/edge change, not UAR.
- **F7. The parent plan's 12 changes do not contain the paper's Phase 0 controls.** These are named in `agent-led-site.md` §8 and §10 but not in the KBD plan:
  - `gate-ext-authz-endpoint`, `gate-site-credentials`;
  - `site-session-binding`, `site-proxy-hardening`, `site-proxy-artifact-filter`;
  - `kb-chunking-quality`, `ci-secrets-out`, `site-session-erasure`, `site-spend-ceiling`.

  The plan describes building and deploying the site; the paper says the site must not take public traffic until those controls exist. The adjusted plan has to merge them or gate the cutover (`apex-dns-cutover`) on them.
- **F8. The paper's §3.3 conversion figure is stale.** "AI-referred visitors converted 9% less" was Feb 2025 data; Adobe reports AI-referred visitors outperforming for 11 straight months to July 2026 [L69]–[L71]. This is a doc correction, not a plan change.

## Gaps ranked for the site's Phase 0/1

1. Gate ext_authz endpoint and site credentials (U4, U9) — platform, outside UAR; blocks the auth model.
2. Session binding (FR-34) — site server; any visitor with a thread UUID can continue another's conversation.
3. `runtime.know-me.tools` exposure and CI-held secrets (T6, T14) — ordering-critical, must precede first deploy.
4. Grounding: chunking fix (U3) **or** full-context mode (F4).
5. Session erasure (U2) — operator purge for Phase 0, UAR change for real.
6. Spend ceiling — set `extensions.budgets` now (F2); cross-replica later.
7. Bot verification on the chat route (F6).
8. Proxy hardening and artifact filter (FR-42, FR-45).
9. Injection blocking flag (F3).
10. `activate_skill` exemption (U1) — not a Phase 0 blocker at `deny`.

## Proposed UAR roadmap candidates (general value, for the plan stage to weigh)

| Candidate | General-use beneficiaries | Site need |
|---|---|---|
| Session delete + TTL cascading across all four stores | Every multi-user deployment | U2 |
| Remove `activate_skill` when `skills.mode == none` (or subject it to policy) | Every tenant with skills off | U1, Phase 2 |
| Structure-aware chunker with minimum chunk size | Every KB tenant | U3 |
| AG-UI 1.0 usage/metadata on the stream; OTel GenAI spans with `session.id` | Every client, evals, billing | U18, observability |
| Cross-replica budget aggregation (shared store) | Every horizontally scaled deployment | Phase 1+ |
| Output guardrail hook | Every public agent | Brand safety |
| Durable API key store | BossFang, any key-auth tenant | None once gate JWTs land |
| Full-context KB mode (attach small KBs to context instead of retrieving) | Small-corpus agents generally | F4 |

Explicitly **not** UAR's job (would distort the runtime): per-IP limiting, bot verification, visitor-identity issuance, artifact filtering on the public path, AI-disclosure UI. These stay in the site server, edge or gate.

## Open questions for plan

1. F4: full-context grounding, or keep RAG to demonstrate the product? (operator)
2. F7: merge the paper's Phase 0 controls into this phase's plan, or gate `apex-dns-cutover` on a separate phase? (operator)
3. Spend ceiling numbers (D-3) — needed to fill `extensions.budgets`.
4. Which UAR roadmap candidates the parent phase owns versus a UAR phase in the UAR repo.

## Unverified

- Whether UAR emits usage in AG-UI 1.0 form and `session.id` on spans (grep found no `gen_ai.*`; not traced at runtime).
- The CI image build after #324 merges.
- Landscape items marked unverified in `research/landscape.md`: ChatKit limits, AgentCore Policy GA date, AG-UI 1.0 field names, the Art. 50(2) deferral.
- The 200k-token threshold is a vendor recommendation [L56] for Claude-class context windows; it has not been tested with `qwen3.8-max`.

## The uncomfortable part

This phase has been building and deploying the site as if the deployment were the goal. The paper this project wrote says the site must not take public traffic until about nine controls exist, and none of them are in the KBD plan (F7). Finishing the 12 planned changes would produce a publicly reachable concierge with a shared principal, no session binding, no bot verification and no erasure. The adjusted plan has to make the cutover depend on those controls, even though that moves the visible milestone further out.
